# RouteRiff

RouteRiff is a free browser-first, second-pass itinerary checker. Bring an existing travel plan, map its major stops, inspect rough geographic travel load and backtracking, reorder or remove stops, and share or remix the result. It can generate a correction prompt for the AI that drafted the itinerary. No account is required for the current validation version.

Canonical product URL: https://routeriff.vercel.app/

## What the checker does

- Accepts plain-text stops, common AI itinerary formats, and local TXT, Markdown, or common CSV files.
- Maps 2–12 major stops, estimates straight-line distance and rough transfer load, and flags long jumps, possible backtracking, and pacing pressure when trip days are supplied.
- Supports manual reordering, a simple middle-stop optimizer, a visual route playback, and shareable or remixable route URLs.
- Offers optional booking exits after route review. Some exits are affiliate links; they do not influence the route score.

## Limits

RouteRiff does not provide live train or flight schedules, road routes, visas, opening hours, prices, availability, or booking advice. Its distance and travel-time estimates are planning heuristics. Verify critical details with official sources and booking providers before paying.
